title: Leo and the Question That Wouldn't Start
subtitle: Knowing is not the same as being ready to speak
description: Leo knew every answer - except how to raise his hand. A public comparison turns classroom participation into fog. Ms Chen repairs privately and opens three genuine routes back into learning. The final page gives parents, carers and educators a key message and practical ideas for shared discussion and rehearsal.
